and assert on its actual return value, not a mock.

intro: This is a DataSHIELD CLIENT-side function, tested against DSLite (an
in-process, serverless implementation of the DataSHIELD server
interface) — real execution and real assertions, not mocking. No
DSLite test setup exists yet for this package, so one will be
generated using one of DSLite's built-in canned datasets. Pick the
single best-fitting option and return its name as dslite_dataset
outro: The generated setup file logs in and defines `conns` (the DSLite
connections to pass as `datasources`), with the chosen dataset
already assigned on every study under the symbol `D` — so refer to
it as "D" (and its columns as e.g. "D$LAB_TSC"), and do NOT write
your own login/connection code. Server-side methods are registered
